text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...I certainly feel like I gave it my all 
"in the moment." And I achieved a result 
that leads to the Japan Derby. And yet—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(This indescribable haze in my chest... 
What on earth is it...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, the Japanese Derby is right 
around the corner...!)

Despite achieving a solid result in the 
Aoba Sho, for some reason, Mejiro Ardan's 
expression remained clouded...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Trainer. Next up is 
finally the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Drawing on today's results, I will work 
even harder in the little time we have 
left... So please, continue to guide me.

At first glance, Mejiro Ardan seems 
completely normal, and her condition 
doesn't appear bad at all. However... I 
can't shake this lingering sense of 
unease.
choice_data_list: (Looks like I need to be careful...)

text_block_list.text: The day after the Aoba Sho—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Looking at everyone running in the 
'Japanese Derby', my eyes just keep 
drifting towards Yaeno-san and Chiyono 
O-san...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(In their recent races, the two of them 
had shown growth far beyond my 
imagination—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(And in the Japanese Derby, I'm sure 
she'll show the exact same terrifying 
level of conditioning.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Because I know Chiyono O and the others 
so well... I can tell.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (At this rate, at the Nippon Derby—)
